name: @dethernety/byodt-console
description: The deployment operator console — a Go binary (init one-shot + status daemon) that embeds the SPA under ui/. Scripts-only workspace manifest; the deployable is the Go binary built by ./Dockerfile. The SPA under ui/ is a self-contained --ignore-workspace package embedded at build time.

scripts.test: bash build-assets.sh && go test ./... && pnpm --dir ui --ignore-workspace test
scripts.docker: bash build-assets.sh && docker build --build-arg VERSION="${VERSION:-}" -f Dockerfile -t byodt-console ../..
